NORTH PIER / OPERATOR HANDOVER MEMO
Recovered from the telegraph desk drawer.

The night operator did not use a personal password for dispatches.
For routine coded messages, the operator used the station call-sign as
the repeating word.

The call-sign on the old office plaque was:

    NORTH PIER

Before typing it into the cipher wheel, the operator removed spaces
and used letters only.

The same word was repeated for the full length of each message.
